transport: App RPC response values; canonical C1 JSON; at most 60000 bytes before the existing RPC envelope. No keys are added to C4 v1.

health.snapshot.page.v2.snapshot_sha256: null initially; exact first-page digest subsequently

items.label: approved contact label
items.pairing: null or {method,verified_at,verified_at_ms}; timestamp aliases are identical safe integers

items.code: refusal exactly when state is failed; null otherwise

replies.refusals.counts: exactly envelope, signature, recipient, stranger, replay, payload, stale_contact, total, last_aura_sequence; safe nonnegative integers
replies.settings.plugins: exact app/faces/plugins/contract.json reply; runtime state must come from the shell
replies.settings.presets: exact app/faces/presets/contract.json reply; operations use underscore spellings

health.snapshot.snapshot_b64: complete unchanged canonical snapshot in standard padded base64, only when entire reply fits

health.snapshot.page.v2.total_bytes: complete snapshot byte length, at most 65536
health.snapshot.page.v2.chunk_b64: standard padded base64 of at most 24576 bytes

health_reassembly: Concatenate decoded chunks in exact offset order; require identical digest and total_bytes; verify digest then use canon health_decode_snapshot. Never paint incomplete chunks. Changed snapshots refuse and restart.
contact_aliases: Humangraph reads key and verified_at_ms; Messages reads npub and verified_at. Both aliases retain the same approved person key and observed timestamp; neither gives authority.
unavailable: Missing sources refuse supervisor:<reason>; no fabricated empty state, grant, key, plugin, history or health evidence.

session_stream_event_v3.session_id: the store-owned dispatch fence session id

event.body: unchanged canon v2 model event body

session_stream_event_v3.binding: Supervisor binds only broker-admitted request/reservation ids to the durable dispatch fence; unknown or cross-principal streams refuse.

http.response: the corresponding reply value in replies
http.authorization: frontdoor closed face grants, currently approved release/floor, and live shell session; supervisor rechecks subject and epoch
http.health_page_grant: health.snapshot.page.v2 is the paged transport of the coherence face health.snapshot read
